sloka: इदानीम् अकृत अर्थानाम् मर्तव्यम् न अत्र संशयः ।हरि राजस्य संदेशम् अकृत्वा कः सुखी भवेत् ॥४-५३-१२॥
transliteration: idānīm akṛta arthānām martavyam na atra saṁśayaḥ ।hari rājasya saṁdeśam akṛtvā kaḥ sukhī bhavet ॥4-53-12॥

translations.english: 'This Vindhya mountain has a rich collection of trees and bushes. This is Prasravana hill and this is the great ocean.O monkeys. Good luck to you. (Now) I am going back home'. Having said so, Svayamprabha entered the splendid cave.
